description: Merge two contigs over a known suffix(contig1)/prefix(contig2) overlap: contig1 + contig2 without its first overlapLength bases (overlapLength 0 = concatenation; must be in [0, shorter contig length], else an error). By default contig1's bases are kept in the overlap; resolveOverlapConflicts = true resolves overlap mismatches/Ns with the EMBOSS merger rule (N yields to the other base, otherwise the base from the contig with the higher local base-quality window wins; ties keep contig1).

overlapLength.description: Length of the suffix/prefix overlap to collapse, in [0, min(|contig1|, |contig2|)].

resolveOverlapConflicts.description: Resolve mismatches / N in the overlap by the EMBOSS merger rule instead of keeping contig1's bases.

errors.message: overlapLength is negative or exceeds the shorter contig

examples.name: Overlap mismatch resolved by EMBOSS merger rule
